svg.title: MS-BTE: subband energies, occupation balance, and electron current
svg.desc: An equation-led cover for scalar multi-subband Boltzmann transport. Parabolic subband energy E_n(x,k)=epsilon_n(x)+hbar squared k squared/(2m*) sets velocity v_n=partial_k E_n/hbar and force F_n=-partial_x E_n. The occupation balance is partial_t f_n+v_n partial_x f_n+(F_n/hbar)partial_k f_n=C_n[f]. The local electron-flow current is g_s e/h times the sum of the energy integrals of f_n,+ minus f_n,- above epsilon_n(x). Both directional occupations are evaluated at the same x,E,t. The spin factor g_s=2 assumes identical spin populations, and conventional charge current has the opposite sign.
svg.text: Directional occupations at the same (x, E, t)
